fairness.G1_optimizer_EMA: Every fresh arm reseeds and loads only fixed map; native strict map startup and source SHA match checked. Continued arms use strict model state and true Lightning optimizer/scheduler plus recorded training RNG.
fairness.full_train_manifest: 493542 entries; seed-specific permutation written once per invocation. B256/B512 endpoints match actual scene exposure despite final partial batches.
fairness.epoch_order: Fresh multi-epoch runs repeat the full seeded order (shuffle=False). This is explicit experimental order; native long recommended config uses shuffle=True.
fairness.continuation: Only first-epoch continuation permitted. Saved_global_step*batch_size slices previously consumed full batches; loader-local progress resets, optimizer/global step remains. Current active train transform has no stochastic branch.
fairness.normalizer: CLI calibration applied at fresh start, exact tensors checked after checkpoint restore; saved calibration file SHA must match metadata. Log size calibration reuses same TRAIN8192 manifest, changes only intended representation.
fairness.full_50000: Final evaluation restores model recipe but reapplies current matched mode and require_full_set=true. Official evaluator rejects mismatched membership. Source checkpoint step preserved rather than evaluation CLI steps1.
fairness.GEN_aggregation: GEN2817/3817 average within each TRAIN seed; aggregate across TRAIN seeds817/1817/2817. Three TRAIN seeds, not six independent models. New evaluator resets accumulated histograms/seen scenes before each GEN evaluation.
fairness.optimizer_sd: Complete optimizer/schedule recipe comparison: grouped AdamW eps1e-7, released weight decay convention, warmup0; default optimizer uses epoch cosine128. It is not a grouping-only intervention.

restart_recovery.durability: Exact argv/absolute output/state/returncode/PID/time saved via flushed fsync + atomic rename + directory fsync.
restart_recovery.skip_requirement: Identical argv/output + saved returncode0 + completed/success state + nonempty readable protocol/summary + exact terminal DONE for output. Prior artifact hashes must remain equal.
restart_recovery.partial_or_failed: Refuse automatic replay, require explicit manual checkpoint recovery. Existing nonempty output without manifest also refused.
restart_recovery.crash_after_successful_exit: Completed status with returncode0 but no artifact hashes can be verified and finalized on restart.
restart_recovery.external_phase1: Initial phase1 remains externally started; main waits for its DONE and verifies14 endpoint arms. Per-stage execution manifests apply to subsequent queued stages.

remaining_limits: No continuation of a partial stage is automatic; intentional manual checkpoint recovery is required.
